en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moamar Bin Khallad, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are the people reporting regarding eating the clay and its abhorrence?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, that is the wet and the loam’.
en.sarwar: 7. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’ammar ibn Khallad who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about what people narrate as regards eating clay and that it is undesirable. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is clay and chunks of dirt.’”
